title: SDDTaskDefinition
description: Structured task manifest for dispatching missions to AI agents within the SDD framework.

task_id.description: Unique task identifier formatted as task_YYYYMMDD_slug

intent_vibe.description: Natural language developer vibe or feature concept

target_component.description: Identifier of the target component in system-blueprint.yaml

target_spec.description: Relative path to target contract or specification (e.g. specs/contracts/api-v1.yaml)

affected_files.description: List of paths or globs within the allowed blast radius

acceptance_criteria.description: Deterministic list of requirements the implementation must fulfill

verification_commands.description: Automated shell commands to run after agent finishes to assert correctness
